نؤتلق (form VIII)
# نُؤْتَلَقُ (nuʔtalaqu) /nuʔ.ta.la.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# نُؤْتَلَقَ (nuʔtalaqa) /nuʔ.ta.la.qa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# نُؤْتَلَقْ (nuʔtalaq) /nuʔ.ta.laq/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
